fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Active contracts accept advances and Progress Claims. Move to Defect Liability after final handover; retention releases remain possible until Closed.

fields.label: Contract Value
fields.description: Total contract value excluding VAT. Used for the retention cap and advance percentage checks.

fields.label: Advance %
fields.description: Mobilization advance as % of contract value. A warning is raised if recorded advances exceed this.

fields.label: Recovery % per Claim
fields.description: Portion of each claim used to pay back the advance. Example: 10% means every certificate repays 10% of its value until the advance is fully recovered. The app stops automatically at the remaining balance.

fields.label: Advance Amount - blank = auto
fields.description: Net basis: yeh NET amount hai aur VAT upar se add hoti hai (e.g. 464,681.80 -> VAT 69,702.27 -> total 534,384.07). Gross basis: yeh VAT-inclusive total hai. Blank = Advance % entitlement se auto.

fields.label: Advance Amount Basis
fields.options:
Net (VAT added on top)
Gross (VAT inclusive)
fields.description: Net = Advance % of Contract Value is a net entitlement and VAT is added on top. Gross = the same figure is a VAT-inclusive ceiling from which the net taxable amount is derived. Either way the ZATCA prepayment tax row stays Actual + Deduct (VAT charged on the net).

fields.label: Advances
fields.description: System-managed. Rows appear when advance Payment Entries linked to this contract are submitted.

fields.label: Retention %
fields.description: Withheld by the client from each certificate. VAT is still charged on the full certified value per the ZATCA contracting guideline; retention only affects what is collected now.

fields.label: Retention Cap % of Contract Value
fields.description: Maximum total retention as % of contract value (many Saudi contracts cap at 5%). The app stops withholding once the cap is reached. 0 = no cap.

fields.label: Defect Liability Period (Months)
fields.description: Used to compute the expected retention release date shown in the Retention Ledger report.

fields.label: Retention Model
fields.description: Retention is part of the invoiced amount (VAT charged in full) and withheld from payment. The alternative model - invoicing retention separately at release - is planned for a later version.
